result.summary: Removes redundant cache invalidation and UI change notifications for parent transactions when wallet outputs are spent. Deletes MarkInputsDirty and stops CommitTransaction from notifying spent parent transactions. Adds unit tests verifying that spending an output, abandoning a spend, or receiving a spend via mempool does not alter parent transaction cached values.
result.problem: Previously, CWalletTx cached available amounts, requiring spent parent transactions to invalidate their caches and notify the GUI when their outputs were spent. Following #27286, available balance is computed from separate structures while CWalletTx caches only transaction-specific credit, debit, and change amounts that do not change upon spending, leaving the invalidation and GUI notification logic redundant.
evidence: Author notes that since #27286, "the balance is read live from m_txos and mapTxSpends, and CWalletTx cache only its own, tx specific, incoming and outgoing amounts... So the cache invalidation recomputes the same values, and the notification makes the GUI refresh a status that has not changed." (PR description)
Commit 4591142a8f notes that the GUI is the only consumer of the notification, and its status refresh depends on depth, maturity, and abandoned flags, none of which change when an output is spent.
result.scope_notes: Removes the MarkInputsDirty helper and its call sites across wallet.cpp, accompanied by new unit tests in wallet_tests.cpp.
result.card: Removes redundant cache invalidation and GUI change notifications for parent transactions when their outputs are spent. Since #27286, available amounts are tracked separately and CWalletTx caches only static per-transaction credit and debit values, making parent dirty-marking and UI updates superfluous. The author notes that invalidation recomputes identical values and UI rows refresh for statuses that did not change, though no performance benchmarks are provided. There are no dependencies.
